subject: bulider: hash join v2 handle correlated column in other conditions (#56252)
summary: Reviewed ae95f2f vs its first parent. The only runtime behavior change is in `pkg/executor/builder.go` `collectColumnIndexFromExpr`, which is used by HashJoin V2 to extract left/right column indexes referenced by `OtherConditions` (via `extractUsedColumnsInJoinOtherCondition` in `buildHashJoinV2`). Treating `*expression.CorrelatedColumn` as a constant is consistent with its runtime semantics (it evaluates from `Data` and does not depend on the joined row), avoids the previous `panic("unsupported expression")` / mis-indexing when correlated columns appear inside join other-conditions, and preserves correct column-usage extraction for actual left/right columns. Added regression coverage in `pkg/executor/test/jointest/hashjoin/hash_join_test.go` (Issue 56214). Checked upstream/master and the same handling remains, with no later revert/fix suggesting a latent Blocker/High issue in this change.
